title: 1:1 prep - Nadia Fernandez
content:
Date: 2026-03-04
Time: 10:00 AM PT
With: Sam Lee (direct report)
Location: Zoom / 1:1 channel
Duration: 30 min

Purpose:
- Quick sync on current sprint priorities, unblockers, and career/feedback check-in.
- Make decisions on model quantization pilot scope and triage production memory spike.

Agenda:
1) Quick wins / highlights (5 min)
   - Sam: demoed reduced-latency inference config on dev cluster, 12% p99 improvement in local perf tests.
   - Follow-up: check if perf holds on dedicated staging.

2) Current blockers (8 min)
   - Mem spike on dedicated pool when running longpad sequences (seen in ENG-4821). Symptoms: OOMs on 2/3 nodes during synthetic longpad tests.
     - What we've tried: increased KV cache eviction threshold, downgraded batch size, applied older kernel.
     - Still flaky: need root cause (memory leak vs pathological pattern).
   - Action to discuss: approve prioritized postmortem and allocate 1 engineer-day for investigation next week.

3) Prioritization & scope (7 min)
   - Quantization pilot (Q2): decision needed on support for per-layer mixed quantization vs whole-model 4-bit.
     - Tradeoff: mixed gives better quality but more infra complexity; whole-model simpler but risk quality regressions.
   - Proposal: run two small pilots in parallel on canary traffic: mixed for 1 model family (opt-13b) and whole-model for a second (gpt-like-7b).
   - Ask for approval to reserve 2x dedicated nodes for 2 weeks starting 2026-03-10.

4) Career / feedback (6 min)
   - Sam's goals: move towards tech lead-ship for batching/kv cache infra, wants to present at eng demo day.
   - Coach on next steps: own a mini-project (lead design + 2 PRs) by end of Q2, pair with Priya for rollout plan.

5) Action items & next steps (4 min)
   - Summarize responsibilities and due dates; confirm follow-ups.

Notes / talking points (scratch):
- Memory spike could be related to new attention kernel path rolled in PR #124. Check PR trace logs.
- If we need hotfix, prefer throttling longpad requests at router level + graceful fallback to smaller-context variant.
- For quantization pilots: add evaluation set focused on hallucination-sensitive prompts; include existing eval harness from confluence page.
- Remind Sam to update the sprint board and move ENG-4821 to "investigating" with clear acceptance criteria.

Action items (from this meeting):
- Sam: Run heap profile on staging nodes with production-like longpad trace, capture logs and upload to ENG-4821 (due 2026-03-06).
- Nadia: Approve 1 engineer-day allocation for root cause investigation and postmortem (decision by 2026-03-05).
- Priya: Reserve 2 dedicated nodes for quantization pilots (check capacity and cost estimate) and add to calendar (due 2026-03-09).
- Sam + Priya: Draft pilot test plan with success metrics (latency p50/p99, perf CPU/GPU, quality delta) and link to confluence evaluation harness (due 2026-03-10).
- Sam: Prepare a 5-min demo for engineering sync on progress (by 2026-03-17).

Follow-ups (notes to self):
- If heap profile points to kernel-level leak, escalate to Serving Runtime owners and open a cross-team investigation ticket (tag: eng-infra).
- Keep exec-updates light: if incident affects SLAs, notify ops and CS with initial impact estimate.
- Track Sam's career progress: assign quarterly milestone for leading batching infra design doc; schedule monthly check-ins.

References / links to attach:
- ENG-4821 (Jira) - memory spike longpad
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/124 (recent kernel opt)
- Confluence: serving-runtime-weekly postmortem template

Misc (personal notes):
- Praise: call out Sam's quick perf win in front of team next all-hands.
- Ask about workload balance — ensure Sam not overloaded with oncall + pilot ownership.

Next 1:1: 2026-03-11
summary: Manager prep for 1:1 with Sam Lee: blockers (memory spike ENG-4821), quantization pilot decision, career goals, and concrete action items.
